Question: The vertices of a quadrilateral lie on the graph of \(y = \ln x,\) and the \(x\)-coordinates of these vertices are consecutive positive integers. The area of the quadrilateral is \(\ln\dfrac{91}{90}.\) What is the \(x\)-coordinate of the leftmost vertex?
